item.title: NIOH 3 Officially Launches On PS5 And PC: The Souls-like Samurai Epic Is Now Available Worldwide
item.description: Nioh 3 has officially launched and is now available to play with a free demo to try the game out that carries progress over. Experience unique souls-like combat with both Samurai and Ninja styles today.

item.title: NEVERNESS TO EVERNESS Co-Ex Test Beta Goes Live: Dive Into Crime, Cars And Mayhem Once Again
item.description: The anime styled GTA-like game Neverness to Everness latest closed beta is now live on PC/PS5. Earn Twitch Drops for access. Beta features more content with crime pursuits, vehicle mods, jobs and more.

item.title: Arc Raiders CEO Reveals 'Tens of Thousands' of Cheaters Banned as Anti-Cheat Efforts Ramp Up
item.description: Embark Studios CEO has confirmed that Arc Raiders has banned tens of thousands of accounts for cheating, showing that they are taking actions against the issue of cheaters that has been plaguing the game.

item.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH Switch 2 Edition Sells Out In Less Than A Week
item.description: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth's Nintendo Switch 2 physical edition has already sold out at the US Square Enix Store just days after its announcement.

item.title: GRANBLUE FANTASY: RELINK - ENDLESS RAGNAROK Is Coming To Switch 2 This Summer
item.description: Cygames confirms Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok will land on Nintendo Switch 2 this summer, they will be updating the base game with new bosses, characters, and Switch-exclusive local co-op.

item.title: ROBLOX Has Been Banned In Another Country Amid Ongoing Child Safety Concerns
item.description: Egypt's government has implemented a nationwide ban on Roblox, citing risks to children's morals, exposure to violent content, and unrestricted interactions with strangers.

item.title: DIABLO 4 Season 12 Has Some Secret Content Blizzard Hasn't Told Us About Yet
item.description: Blizzard's Diablo 4 Season 12 PTR notes hint at hidden surprises beyond Killstreaks and Bloodied items, set for reveal near launch. Will the new content make it a good season?

item.title: Embark Studios Teases Two New Games In Development After ARC RAIDERS Has Had A Profitable Run
item.description: Embark Studios CEO has confirmed there are two new projects in development, crediting ARC Raiders' success for studio growth and stability, the extraction shooter continues to get monthly updates.

item.title: Discord Will Be Locking Full Access Behind A Face Scan Or ID In Upcoming Update
item.description: Discord announced that it will roll out enhanced teen safety features worldwide starting in early March, where users will have to verify adult status through face scans or ID to have full access.
